title: My stack is pretty much just Claude. Game is for GenX.
author: OkRestaurant960
selftext:
https://preview.redd.it/mbnkyvfhhhuh1.jpg?width=2472&format=pjpg&auto=webp&s=27baf671a13e87be67944dd95f95a9d3603730ae

Claude, VS Code, Godaddy hosting, couple of MCP connectors. Making some music and sounds with Mureka now.

Pic shows the actual process.

In recent months I've asked Claude to ...

\- make a video analyzer, editor and production system (still working on it, very good so far)

\- make graphics and level design consistent, by using a connector to Gemini

\- last week I got a 47-item list of things to consider for consistency, lore, coherence, game feel and more - I'm working on them

On its own it started over recent months to automatically test all changes in a headless browser and report back to me what the player experience is like and if a level can be solved. I didn't ask it to do this. Or I did, indirectly, within the context of months worth of interactions.

So by the time it gives me a new screen to test, the chances it works fine are about 95%, but I will ALWAYS have to tweak the apperance.

I have never exceeded my $100 a month usage limits. I hit a 5-hour session wall maybe twice a month.

Alderhoard is a free browser game: you walk a hand-built valley, repair things, beat a warlord, and find arcade cabinets along the way. Breakout with UFOs and black holes, Pac-Man with ducklings and moving walls, Asteroids, Boulder Dash, a Zork-style text adventure on a C64 screen.
